name: perspective-marquee
title: Perspective Marquee
description: A 3D tilted marquee with depth feel as items roll toward the horizon. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="perspective-marquee": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Tilt
variables.description: How far the marquee plane leans back toward the horizon.

variables.label: Travel
variables.description: Scales the offset the timeline drives, so the strip covers a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Pill colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides the brand token.

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Comma separated pill labels. The list is laid down twice so the strip still reads as a continuous loop.
